title: THE AGRICULTURAL AND PROCESSED FOOD PRODUCTS EXPORT DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY ACT, 1985
long_title: An Act to provide for the establishment of an Authority for the development and promotion of exports of certain agricultural and processed food products and for matters connected therewith.

sections.text: (1) This Act may be called the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority Act, 1985. (2) It extends to the whole of India. (3) It shall come into force on such date as the Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint.

Defines key terms including "Authority" (Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority), "Chairman", "export", "member", "prescribed", "processing", "Scheduled product" (product specified in the First Schedule), "Secretary", "Special product", and other related terms.

The Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, add to or omit from the First Schedule any agricultural or processed food product, and on such notification the Schedule shall be deemed to be amended accordingly.

chapters.chapter_title: AGRICULTURAL AND PROCESSED FOOD PRODUCTS EXPORT DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY

sections.section_title: Establishment and constitution of the Authority
sections.text: (1) With effect from such date as the Central Government may by notification appoint, there shall be established an Authority to be called the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority. (2) The Authority shall be a body corporate with perpetual succession and a common seal, and may sue and be sued in its name. (3) The Authority shall consist of a Chairman and such number of other members as may be prescribed, representing the Central Government, State Governments, exporters, producers, and other interests connected with Scheduled products.

sections.section_title: Salary and Allowances and other conditions of service of Chairman and allowances of members
sections.text: The salary and allowances payable to the Chairman and the other terms and conditions of his service, and the allowances payable to the other members, shall be such as may be prescribed.
The Chairman shall be the chief executive of the Authority and shall exercise such powers and perform such duties as may be prescribed or as may be delegated to him by the Authority.

sections.section_title: Secretary of the Authority and other staff
sections.text: The Central Government shall appoint a Secretary of the Authority and such other officers and employees as it may consider necessary for the efficient performance of the functions of the Authority; their salaries, allowances and conditions of service shall be as prescribed.

sections.section_title: Special provision for transfer of employees to the Authority
sections.text: Provides for the transfer of employees from existing organisations or departments connected with the export of Scheduled products to the Authority on such terms and conditions as may be determined by the Central Government.

The Authority may constitute such committees as it thinks fit for the efficient discharge of its functions, and the composition, powers and functions of such committees shall be as fixed by the Central Government or as prescribed.

(1) It shall be the duty of the Authority to undertake the development and promotion, under the control of the Central Government, of export of Scheduled products. (2) Measures may include: (a) development of industries relating to Scheduled products for export by financial assistance, surveys, feasibility studies, joint ventures, reliefs and subsidies; (b) registration of exporters on payment of prescribed fees; (c) fixing of standards and specifications for export; (d) inspection of meat and meat products in slaughterhouses, processing plants, storage premises etc. to ensure quality; (e) improving packaging; (f) improving marketing outside India; (g) promotion of export-oriented production; (h) collection and publication of statistics; (i) training; (j) such other matters as may be prescribed.

sections.section_title: Functions in respect of Special products, etc.
sections.text: Without prejudice to any law for the time being in force, it shall be the duty of the Authority to undertake measures as may be prescribed by the Central Government for registration and protection of Intellectual Property rights in respect of Special products in India or outside India. "Intellectual Property" means any right to intangible property, namely, trade marks, designs, patents, geographical indications or any other similar intangible property under any law for the time being in force.

If the Central Government is of opinion that the Authority is unable to perform, or has persistently made default in the performance of, the duties imposed on it by or under this Act, or has exceeded or abused its powers, it may, by notification, supersede the Authority for such period as may be specified and make such arrangements for the discharge of the functions of the Authority during the period of supersession as it thinks fit.
No person shall export any Scheduled product unless he is registered as an exporter of that product under this Act and the rules made thereunder.

sections.section_title: Application, cancellation, fee payable and other matters relating to registration
sections.text: Provides for the manner of making application for registration, the fee payable, the conditions of registration, the circumstances in which registration may be cancelled or suspended, and other related matters, as may be prescribed.

sections.section_title: Returns to be made by exporters
sections.text: Every registered exporter shall furnish to the Authority such returns relating to the Scheduled products exported by him as may be prescribed, at such intervals and in such form as may be prescribed.

sections.section_title: Grants or loans by the Central Government
sections.text: The Central Government may, after due appropriation made by Parliament by law in this behalf, make to the Authority grants or loans of such sums of money as that Government may consider necessary.

sections.section_title: Constitution of Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Fund
sections.text: There shall be constituted a Fund to be called the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Fund, and there shall be credited thereto all grants and loans made by the Central Government, all fees received, and all other sums received by the Authority.
The Authority may, with the previous approval of the Central Government, borrow money from any source, whether in India or outside, on such terms and conditions as may be approved by that Government.

The Authority shall maintain proper accounts and other relevant records and prepare an annual statement of accounts in such form as may be prescribed; the accounts shall be audited by the Comptroller and Auditor-General of India, and the audited accounts together with the audit report shall be forwarded to the Central Government for being laid before Parliament.

sections.section_title: Power to prohibit or control imports and exports of Scheduled products
sections.text: The Central Government may, by order published in the Official Gazette, prohibit, restrict or otherwise control the import or export of any Scheduled product, or regulate the quality or standards of such products for export.

The Authority shall be bound by such directions on questions of policy as the Central Government may give in writing from time to time; the decision of the Central Government whether a question is one of policy or not shall be final.

The Authority shall furnish to the Central Government such returns, statistics, accounts and other information as that Government may from time to time require, and shall prepare and submit an annual report on its activities.

If any person required to furnish any return or information under this Act makes any statement which is false in any material particular, he shall be punishable with fine which may extend to the prescribed amount, or with imprisonment, or with both.

sections.section_title: Penalties for obstructing a member or officer of the Authority in the discharge of his duty and for failure to produce books and records
sections.text: Whoever obstructs any member or officer of the Authority in the discharge of his duties, or fails to produce any book, account or other document when required, shall be punishable as provided under the Act.
Whoever contravenes any provision of this Act or any rule or order made thereunder for which no other penalty is provided shall be punishable with fine which may extend to the amount prescribed.

Where an offence under this Act has been committed by a company, every person who at the time the offence was committed was in charge of, and was responsible to, the company for the conduct of its business, as well as the company, shall be deemed to be guilty of the offence and shall be liable to be proceeded against and punished accordingly, subject to the usual proviso regarding lack of knowledge or exercise of due diligence.
No court inferior to that of a Metropolitan Magistrate or a Judicial Magistrate of the first class shall try any offence under this Act.

sections.section_title: Previous sanction of the Central Government
sections.text: No prosecution for any offence under this Act shall be instituted except with the previous sanction of the Central Government or such officer as may be authorised by that Government in this behalf.

sections.section_title: Protection of action taken in good faith
sections.text: No suit, prosecution or other legal proceeding shall lie against the Central Government, the Authority, or any member, officer or employee for anything which is in good faith done or intended to be done under this Act or any rule or order made thereunder.

The Central Government may, by notification, direct that any power exercisable by it under this Act (except the power to make rules) may also be exercised by such officer or authority as may be specified in the notification.

sections.section_title: Suspension of operation of this Act
sections.text: If the Central Government is satisfied that circumstances have arisen rendering it necessary that the operation of this Act or any provision thereof should be suspended in any area, it may, by notification, suspend the operation of this Act or such provision in that area for such period as may be specified.

sections.section_title: Application of other laws not barred
sections.text: The provisions of this Act shall be in addition to, and not in derogation of, any other law for the time being in force relating to the export of agricultural or processed food products.

The Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, make rules for carrying out the purposes of this Act, including rules relating to the composition of the Authority, conditions of service, fees, standards, registration, returns, and other matters.

The Authority may, with the previous approval of the Central Government, make regulations consistent with this Act and the rules made thereunder to provide for all matters for which provision is necessary or expedient for the purpose of giving effect to the provisions of this Act.

sections.section_title: Rules and regulations to be laid before Parliament
sections.text: Every rule and every regulation made under this Act shall be laid, as soon as may be after it is made, before each House of Parliament, while it is in session, for a total period of thirty days, and shall be subject to such modification or annulment as both Houses may agree.
Provides for validation of actions taken under the Act or any previous corresponding law, as may be specified.

schedules.title: THE FIRST SCHEDULE
schedules.description: List of Scheduled products (agricultural and processed food products) in respect of which the Authority exercises its functions; the list may be amended by notification under section 3.

schedules.title: THE SECOND SCHEDULE
schedules.description: Matters in respect of which the Authority may make regulations under section 33.
